name: Trusting And Believing
overview: Scripture reveals that trusting and believing in the LORD brings strength, protection, and renewed vitality. The psalmist declares the LORD as his strength and shield, resulting in heartfelt rejoicing and praise. Those who dwell in God's presence and fix their hearts on Him need not fear evil, for humility and reverence toward the LORD bring honor and life. Trusting God empowers believers to endure without weariness, as Jesus encourages faith over fear in times of trial.
